rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken adjective when something may happen but is not certain.

example.english: It is possible that this will happen.
example.jyutping: ni1 gin6 si6 jau5 ho2 nang4 faat3 sang1

rows.note: Use this for a plan, method, or proposal that can realistically be carried out.

example.traditional: 呢個方案喺技術上可行。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 fong1 on3 hai2 gei6 seot6 soeng6 ho2 hang4
